$comment: The toolchain every app on the baseline needs, checked by the doctor program. `tools` are versioned (a minimum), `commands` pass or fail on their exit status, `env` must be set. An entry with `when` applies only when that file exists in the repository being checked. A repository adds or replaces entries by name in its own doctor.requirements.json, and drops one with `"skip": true`. The maestro minimum must not be newer than MAESTRO_VERSION in scripts/lib/versions.sh.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.hint: Install Xcode 26.4+ from the App Store, then: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app

tools.name: adb
tools.hint: bash node_modules/@blinkbitcoin/app-tooling/setup/android.sh, then activate mise (or add $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools to PATH)

commands.name: ruby gems
commands.hint: bundle config set --local path vendor/bundle && bundle install
